text:
Type: Persian-style medallion rug
Use: anchoring a sofa or bed area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: traditional, bohemian, classic
Materials: low flat woven pile
Colors: deep warm red, steel blue, cream, navy
Shape: rectangular, dense allover floral medallion pattern, multiple ornate borders, thin low profile, medium size
Feel: rich, warm, inviting
Goes with: wood floors, charcoal or leather sofas, plants, brass; traditional or eclectic rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Medallion-Patterned Rug, 5' x 8', Red and Steel Blue
product.description: This transitional rug boasts a multicolored pattern with a handstitched binding that adds elegance to any room. The soft, thick pile gives it a luxurious feel, great for tired feet. Durable nylon helps prevent wear and tear, keeping the rug looking beautiful. 5'W X 8'L Pile: 100% nylon; back: 100% cotton This durable nylon rug has a handstitched edging. A low pile makes this rug especially practical for outdoor use or high-traffic areas. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
